This episode is about a mix of old and new Singapore. Following are the activities done during the day.
Date of Journey - 3 July
Following
Merlion - Most popular tourist location - right in front of MBS- Marina Bay sands.
Fullerton Hotel - Old heritage hotel
Mahatama Gandhi Immersion - Walking distance from Merlion
Capita Spring Building - Terrace visit is free with prior booking.Try to book 15 to 20 days in advance.
Yakun kaya Toast - 3 SGD, egg 2 pieces - 2.2 SGD, coffee 2.2 SGD This is a popular breakfast joint of Singapore with multiple branches.
